encounter.title: Act I Encounter 5 — Square Candidate A (7x7 seed 20)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate A for Act I #5. 7x7 seed 20 (10 arrows: N3 E3 S0 W4). Combines melee flank pressure with artillery disruption. Pattern: CHOICE OF OPENING. 5 arrows free across 3 directions on start (N1, E1, W3). Starting with West or North allows Grunt E to hit on turn 3 for 2 damage. Intended sequence: #2(N) -> #3(E) -> #9(E) (kills Grunt E on turn 3 right on deadline) -> #4(W) -> #7(N) (kills Thrower N on turn 5). 5 taps clean, 0 damage.
